The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Satele Shan]] rediscovered a '''hyperspace route''' that led to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], drawing on [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of research and meditation, which allowed the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to return to their long-lost [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. For her achievement, Shan was granted the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].<ref name="TORE" />
